rationale: TopKGate applies topk to raw logits instead of post-softmax gates. Detection_method=source_analysis indicates this is not directly runtime-observable from a single trace field; must be caught at build-time by asserting the routing implementation. Borderline numerical vs moe: chose moe because the bug is specific to MoE router algorithm, not generic numerical math. parallel_dim=none because single-GPU MoE reproduces (anti-example 6). pi_precond=true (precond is module_class==TopKGate); pattern P8 because runtime traces cannot easily distinguish topk-of-logits vs topk-of-softmax.
